title: Juice N Power Tropical Fruit Nic Salt E-Liquid 5mg
description: Packed full of juicy tropical fruit flavours, let this delicious e-liquid whisk you away to sun-soaked beaches, with waves of juicy fruits blooming over your tastebuds. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production and the nicotine salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts with a super-smooth throat hit.
